desc:
A ragdoll sandbox where every shot counts. Dummies react to exactly where you hit them, and keep reacting after they fall.

👍 Like & Join the group for more updates!

🎯 Hit the heart or lungs and they collapse. Hit a limb and they clutch the wound and try to crawl away.
🩸 Bullet holes, bleeding, and limbs that come clean off.
😨 Every dummy has a personality: some run, some freeze, some come closer.
🔫 Pistols, rifles, shotguns, snipers, a bow, RPGs, grenade launchers and melee weapons.
🗺️ Stop a gas station robbery, pull off a bank heist, or survive the WWI trenches.
🚗 Carry and throw bodies, launch them with cars, and slow down time to watch every hit.

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile and Tablet!
